name: Shayona - Saree Missing Catalog Image Generator (AI)

parameters.content:
## Setup Required Before Activating
1. **Set Configuration** node: fill ROOT_FOLDER_ID (parent Drive folder containing all barcode folders), GEMINI_API_MODEL (e.g. gemini-2.5-flash-image), ERROR_LOG_SPREADSHEET_ID, ERROR_LOG_SHEET_NAME.
2. Attach a **Google Drive OAuth2** credential to every Google Drive node (search/download/upload/update).
3. Create a **Generic Query Auth** credential named '<REDACTED>' with Query Parameter Name = `key` and Value = your Generative Language API key. Attach it to both Gemini HTTP Request nodes.
4. Attach a **Google Sheets OAuth2** credential to the error log Append node.
5. Image roles are fixed by filename only: 1.png=Barcode/Tag, 4.png=Folded Saree, 5.png=Saree Flat (input), 6.png=Blouse Fabric (input). 3.png and 2.png are AI-generated outputs. 1.png and 4.png are never touched.
6. Retries: Drive ops x3, AI generation x3 (with continueErrorOutput + 5s wait), upload/update x3.

parameters.jsCode:
const v = $input.item.json;
const prompt = "Convert the provided blouse fabric piece into a realistic stitched blouse product photograph.

STRICT FABRIC PRESERVATION RULES:
Use the uploaded fabric image as the ONLY source.
Preserve 100% of the original design.
Preserve color exactly.
Preserve motifs exactly.
Preserve embroidery exactly.
Preserve print exactly.
Preserve texture exactly.
Preserve weaving exactly.
Preserve border exactly.
Preserve fabric placement exactly where possible.

DO NOT:
Redesign
Recreate
Enhance
Beautify
Reinterpret
Add patterns
Remove patterns
Change colors
Change embroidery
Change motifs
Change texture
Change border

GARMENT SHAPE:
Women's blouse
Front view only
Simple round neck OR U-neck
Plain neckline
No lace
No piping
No border additions
No patti
No decorative elements
No tassels
No accessories
No designer neck
No embroidery additions
Half sleeves
Symmetrical stitching
Realistic tailoring

PHOTOGRAPHY:
Pure white background
Soft shadow
Studio lighting
Premium e-commerce catalog style

DO NOT INCLUDE:
Model
Mannequin
Hanger
Jewelry
Text
Logo
Watermark
Background objects

CRITICAL:
The ONLY transformation allowed is converting the fabric piece into a stitched blouse shape.
The fabric design itself must remain completely unchanged.";

return {
  json: {
    ...v,
    geminiRequestBody: {
      contents: [
        {
          parts: [
            { text: prompt },
            { inline_data: { mime_type: v.blouseFabricMimeType, data: v.blouseFabricBase64 } }
          ]
        }
      ],
      generationConfig: { responseModalities: ['IMAGE'] }
    }
  }
};

const v = $input.item.json;
const prompt = "Create a premium e-commerce catalog image using ONLY the supplied saree image and supplied blouse image.

STRICT DESIGN PRESERVATION RULES:
Use the saree image exactly as supplied.
Use the blouse image exactly as supplied.
Preserve every color.
Preserve every motif.
Preserve every embroidery element.
Preserve every border.
Preserve every texture.
Preserve every print.
Preserve every fabric detail.

DO NOT:
Redesign fabric
Regenerate fabric
Recreate patterns
Change colors
Add embroidery
Remove embroidery
Add borders
Change borders
Enhance design
Beautify design
Invent details

LAYOUT:
Professional Indian ethnicwear catalog presentation.
Neatly arranged saree.
Matching blouse placed beside saree.
Entire product visible.
Natural proportions.
Balanced composition.
Premium marketplace style.

BACKGROUND:
Pure white background.
Soft natural shadow.
Premium e-commerce photography style.

DO NOT ADD:
Model
Mannequin
Accessories
Jewelry
Flowers
Furniture
Props
Branding
Logo
Text
Watermark

CRITICAL:
This is a composition task only.
Absolutely no redesign, recoloring, enhancement, pattern regeneration, or fabric modification is allowed.";

return {
  json: {
    ...v,
    geminiRequestBody: {
      contents: [
        {
          parts: [
            { text: prompt },
            { inline_data: { mime_type: v.sareeImageMimeType, data: v.sareeImageBase64 } },
            { inline_data: { mime_type: v.blouseGeneratedMimeType, data: v.blouseGeneratedBase64 } }
          ]
        }
      ],
      generationConfig: { responseModalities: ['IMAGE'] }
    }
  }
};

const errors = $json.errors || [];
return errors.map(e => ({ json: e }));
